title: servo, motor-reducer and closed-loop drive modules

specimens.name: AC servo motor with rear encoder housing
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Compact finned industrial AC servo motor with clean flange mount, short output shaft and distinct rear encoder/resolver housing; connector sockets may be molded into the body but no cables are attached.

specimens.name: Servo motor with inline planetary gearbox
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Precision servo motor joined to a compact coaxial planetary gearbox with repeatable flange geometry and one output shaft; no surrounding machine, cable or control box.

specimens.name: Servo motor with right-angle gear reducer
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Compact servo motor joined to a precision right-angle worm or bevel gear reducer with a machined output shaft and serviceable cast housing; no external drivetrain.

specimens.name: Motorized ballscrew linear actuator
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Short enclosed or semi-enclosed electric linear actuator with servo motor, ballscrew housing, sliding rod/carriage and end-bearing blocks; no larger mechanism, cable or frame.

specimens.name: Electric rotary actuator with integrated brake
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Compact cast rotary actuator module with electric motor section, reduction housing, integrated brake can and one output flange; no external linkage or control wiring.

specimens.name: Direct-drive torque-motor rotary module
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Compact low-profile annular torque-motor/rotary-stage drive module with central bore, precision mounting flange and encoder ring housing; physical drive only, no complete turntable or instrument.

specimens.name: Closed-loop voice-coil short-stroke linear actuator
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Compact direct-drive voice-coil actuator with a visibly short precision linear stroke: cylindrical stationary magnetic yoke around a sliding moving-coil cartridge, two short parallel flexure guides and a small dedicated optical-position-feedback housing. No output rotary shaft, finned generic motor, encoder can, leads, wires, ballscrew, hydraulic rod, solenoid plunger or full test machine. The physical magnetic/coil stage and straight-line motion axis must read differently from the AC servo motor in specimen 01.

specimens.name: Electrohydraulic servo cylinder with position-transducer body
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Precision hydraulic cylinder with polished rod, clevis ends, compact integrated servo-valve block and a visible linear position-transducer housing; no hoses, external manifold or complete hydraulic system.

era_contract.character: late-1990s closed-loop test-center actuation dominated by servo motors, motor-reducers, encoder/resolver feedback and precision electric linear/rotary drives, with electrohydraulic servo retained only where functionally appropriate
required_signals: servo motors with explicit feedback housings
short-stroke closed-loop voice-coil linear positioning with integrated feedback, separate from rotary servo families
replaced_previous_language: E1 generic industrial motors and simple inline gearboxes as the main drive language
guarded belt/chain fragments as common drive vocabulary
basic solenoid or clutch modules standing in for precision motion control
forbidden_regressions: generic motor-only E1 appearance without feedback
improvised motor mounts or whole machines
a second conventional finned motor with rear feedback housing substituted for specimen 07
